subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: 21 February is observed across the country to honour the brave souls who sacrificed their lives for our language. The (a) ------- started when a declaration was made in 1948 that only Urdu would be the state language of Pakistan. This decision triggered (b) ------- in East Pakistan. Ignoring the ban on public gatherings, students of Dhaka University arranged a (c) ------- protest on 21 February 1952. But police fired at the demonstrators near Dhaka Medical College, and several students were (d) -------. Their sacrifice became the inspiration for our future (e) -------. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) movement; (b) outrage; (c) peaceful; (d) killed; (e) liberation;
